response.sql: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), above_average AS (SELECT sex, test_count FROM sex_counts WHERE test_count > (SELECT AVG(test_count) FROM sex_counts)) SELECT sex, test_count, test_count * 1.0 / SUM(test_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, test_count - (SELECT AVG(test_count) FROM sex_counts) AS above_average FROM above_average;
